params.prompt: Locked-off static shot, no camera movement, no zoom, no pan. A thin, clear, steady stream of water keeps pouring from the nozzle into the glass on the drip tray; the water level in the glass rises slowly and steadily; gentle ripples on the surface. The slanted sunbeam stays fixed while faint dust motes drift slowly through it. The appliance stays completely still and unchanged: no lever movement, no shape change, no morphing. No people, no hands, no extra water streams, no splashing out of the glass, no new objects, no flicker, no text changes.
